subject: Physics
question: A 12 kg crate is pushed across a horizontal floor at constant velocity. The coefficient of dynamic friction between the crate and the floor is 0.35. Calculate the pushing force. Take g = 9.81 m/s².
response_text:
At constant velocity the resultant force is zero, so the push equals the friction force.

Normal reaction: R = mg = 12 kg × 9.81 m/s² = 117.72 kg·m/s² = 117.72 N ≈ 118 N
Friction: F = μR = 0.35 × 117.72 N = 41.2 N

So a horizontal push of about 41 N keeps the crate moving at constant velocity.

correct_steps: a horizontal push of about 41 N
